answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring every identity to forge its standing through a stake that can be slashed: each agent locks a bond, and peers attest only to work they have directly verified, so one operator cannot mint thousands of trusted copies for free. Like a pearl, credibility grows in thin layers over repeated honest jobs, and a juniper-like mesh of independent attestations makes fake clusters visible, because real agents connect outward in many directions while sybil farms only vouch for each other.
